name: MonarchAiArtifactCanvas
title: AiArtifactCanvas
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet (or a Column pane) with androidx.compose.material3.SecondaryTabRow, composing MonarchAiMarkdown, MonarchAiCodeBlock, MonarchCopyButton and MonarchButton; android.webkit.WebView through androidx.compose.ui.viewinterop.AndroidView for HTML
summary: The working surface for an artifact an assistant produced: title and version, Copy, Download and Save, an optional version stepper, and Preview and Code tabs, as a full-height sheet on phones.
whenToUse: When a reply produced a document, code, a table, a chart, an image or a web page the person opens, reads, copies or saves, usually from MonarchAiArtifactCard.
whenNotToUse: For a short snippet inside the reply, use MonarchAiCodeBlock or MonarchAiMarkdown in the message. For a file the person uploaded, use the file preview.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiArtifactCanvas(artifact: MonarchAiCanvasArtifact, open: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placement: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement.Auto, tab: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasTab? = null, onTabChange: ((MonarchAiArtifactCanvasTab) -> Unit)? = null, image: Painter? = null, onCopy: ((MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, onDownload: ((MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, onSave: (suspend (MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, closeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, versions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, preview: (@Composable (MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels())

@ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiArtifactCanvas(artifact: MonarchAiCanvasArtifact, open: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, kindIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, placement: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement.Auto, tab: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasTab? = null, onTabChange: ((MonarchAiArtifactCanvasTab) -> Unit)? = null, image: Painter? = null, onCopy: ((MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, onDownload: ((MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, onSave: (suspend (MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, closeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, versions: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, preview: (@Composable (MonarchAiCanvasArtifact) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels())
data class MonarchAiCanvasArtifact(val id: String, val kind: MonarchAiArtifactKind, val title: String, val version: Int, val content: String, val language: String? = null)
enum class MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement { Auto, Inline, Sheet }

class MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels(label: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiArtifactKind) -> String)? = null, version: ((version: Int) -> String)? = null, preview: String? = null, code: String? = null, close: String? = null, copy: String? = null, copied: String? = null, download: String? = null, save: String? = null, frameTitle: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, sandboxNote: String? = null, imageUnavailable: String? = null, noPreview: String? = null)

options.name: artifact
options.description: The version shown: id, kind, title, version number, content as text and the language of the Code tab.

options.name: onDismissRequest
options.description: Called by the close button and, on a sheet, by the back gesture, a swipe down or a tap outside. Set open to false.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the sheet or the pane. Give a pane a bounded height.

options.name: placement
options.description: Auto is a full-height sheet below 640dp and a pane from 640dp, as on the web; Inline is always a pane; Sheet is always a sheet.

options.name: tab
options.description: The open tab. null lets the canvas keep it, starting on Preview; kinds without a preview show Code.

options.name: onTabChange
options.description: Called when the person picks a tab.

options.name: image
options.description: The picture of an image artifact, loaded by the app from the artifact's address. Without it the preview says the image is not available.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called after Copy put the content on the clipboard. Copy is always shown.

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Shows Download; the app produces the file.

options.name: onSave
options.description: Shows Save as the primary action. It shows progress until the call returns; taps meanwhile do nothing.

options.name: closeIcon
options.description: The close glyph. Without one the close button is a ghost text button "Close artifact" at the end of the toolbar, because Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: versions
options.description: A version stepper under the title, usually MonarchAiArtifactVersions with the app's versions.

options.name: preview
options.description: Replaces the built-in preview for every kind, such as a chart the app draws. Never render the content as HTML in it.

states.name: document or table
states.description: Preview renders the Markdown with MonarchAiMarkdown; Code shows the Markdown source.

states.name: code or chart
states.description: No Preview tab unless preview is given; the source shows in MonarchAiCodeBlock with line numbers.

states.name: web page
states.description: Preview is a sandboxed WebView that fills the canvas, with "Sandboxed preview: scripts, forms and network requests are blocked." under it.

states.name: image
states.description: Preview shows the app's Painter at full width; without one, a warning line.

states.name: saving
states.description: Save shows the MonarchButton loading state until onSave returns.

states.name: sheet
states.description: A full-height Material 3 modal bottom sheet with its drag handle, announced by its pane title "Artifact: Q3 summary".

states.name: pane
states.description: The same content where the app places it, with the same pane title.

appearance: The title uses the heading style in the default text role with the kind and version under it in the muted caption; Copy and Download are small ghost buttons and Save a small primary button; the tabs are the Material 3 secondary tab row in the theme; the sandbox note is the muted caption and the image warning the warning strong role. The sheet uses the Material 3 sheet surface. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from the theme roles and the composed components.
platformNotes: The web shows a pane beside the thread and a full-screen sheet under 640px; Android does the same with a full-height ModalBottomSheet, so the system back gesture and the drag handle close it. The web closes its pane with Escape and returns focus to the opener; on Android the pane closes with its close button and the app's navigation keeps the back gesture. HTML renders in an android.webkit.WebView, the View the plan names, with JavaScript off, network, file and content access blocked, every navigation refused, a Content Security Policy with no network and no scripts, and scripts, frames, embeds, base, meta refresh and event attributes removed; the web uses an iframe with an empty sandbox. The web loads an image artifact from its URL; Monarch loads no images, so the app passes a Painter. The web's renderPreview can fall back per kind by returning undefined; Android's preview slot replaces the preview for every kind. The web's versions, onVersionChange and onCompare props are a versions slot where the app composes MonarchAiArtifactVersions with its icons. allowImages is not offered: Markdown images stay text, as the web's default. iOS has not built this component yet.
accessibility: The title is a TalkBack heading; the kind and version are read after it.
The sheet and the pane carry the pane title "Artifact: <title>", so TalkBack announces the canvas when it opens.
The tabs are Material 3 tabs, read as selected or not; each has a 48dp target.
The close button is named "Close artifact" and has a 48dp target; without an icon it is a text button at the end of the toolbar.
The web page preview is named "Preview of <title>" and the sandbox is said in words under it.
Copy announces the copy through MonarchCopyButton; Save is read as loading while it runs.
In right to left the close button is at the left; the title wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: The content is untrusted model output: a web page never runs scripts or loads anything from the network, and the app's preview slot must not render it as HTML either.
Code and chart artifacts open on Code even when the tab asked for is Preview.
A pane needs a bounded height (fill a pane of a list-detail layout); in a vertically scrolling parent the inner scroll cannot be measured.
Long content scrolls inside the canvas; the header and the actions stay in place.
Several canvases: open one at a time; each keeps its own tab.

examples.title: Beside a reply, with versions and save
examples.webExample: Beside a reply, with versions and save
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
        Text({{reply}})
        MonarchAiArtifactCard(
            title = {{artifact.title}},
            kind = MonarchAiArtifactKind.{{artifact.kind|pascal}},
            version = version,
            onClick = { open = true },
            active = open,
            icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
            trailingIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
        )
    }
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiArtifactCanvas(
        artifact = MonarchAiCanvasArtifact(
            id = {{artifact.id}},
            kind = MonarchAiArtifactKind.{{artifact.kind|pascal}},
            title = {{artifact.title}},
            version = version,
            content = versions.first { it.version == version }.content.orEmpty(),
        ),
        open = open,
        onDismissRequest = { open = false },
        kindIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Document, contentDescription = null) },
        placement = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasPlacement.Inline,
        onDownload = {},
        onSave = {},
        closeIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
        versions = {
            MonarchAiArtifactVersions(
                selection = version,
                versions = versions,
                onSelectionChange = { version = it },
                previousIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
                nextIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
                menuIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
                locale = locale,
                timeZone = {{timeZone}},
                showCompare = false,
            )
        },
        labels = MonarchAiArtifactCanvasLabels(save = {{saveLabel}}),
    )
}
examples.setup:
var open by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
var version by remember { mutableIntStateOf(2) }
val versions = listOf(
    MonarchAiArtifactVersion(1, 1_773_306_000_000L, content = "# Q3 summary

Revenue grew in every region.

- New customers: 140
- Churn: 2.1%"),
    MonarchAiArtifactVersion(2, 1_773_307_200_000L, label = "Added next steps", content = "# Q3 summary

Revenue grew **12%**, led by the north region.

- New customers: 140
- Churn: 2.1%

## Next steps

Review pricing before the planning meeting."),
)
val locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-GB")
